item.title: Kashmir Man found Dead in Hotel Room
item.description: Srinagar, Jan 6: A dead body was found inside a hotel in the Tangmarg area of north Kashmir’s Baramulla district on Tuesday. An official said that the deceased has been identified as Haziq, a resident of Kulgam, who had been staying at the hotel since last night. Upon receiving information, police from Police Station Tangmarg rushed to the spot and took cognisance of the matter, they said. item.title: Four injured in Early-Morning Road Mishap in Jammu Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 8: At least four people were injured after a vehicle they were travelling in met with an accident at Chaktroo near the police post area of Mandi in Poonch district of Jammu Kashmir on Thursday morning. Officials said that a minibus lost control this morning and turned turtle, resulting in injuries to four people in the Chaktroo area. item.title: Daksum–Sinthan road Closed due to icy conditions
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 8: Authorities on Thursday said that the Daksum–Sinthan road stretch has been closed due to icy conditions as a precautionary measure. Official of the National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd said, due to the formation of ice on the road surface, the Daksum–Sinthan road stretch has been closed to all vehicular traffic in the interest of public safety. item.title: Police intensify Frisking on NH44 ahead of Republic Day
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 8: Police in South Kashmir’s Kulgam district on Thursday intensified checking and frisking operations along the Jammu-Srinagar NH44 in the Qazigund area ahead of Republic Day celebrations to ensure public safety and maintain law and order. item.title: CM Omar Abdullah launches e-Pathshala; says digital learning to supplement teaching, not replace teachers
item.description: Jammu, Jan 8: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Thursday launched the e-Pathshala initiative of the school education department, asserting that digital platforms are meant to supplement classroom teaching and bridge learning gaps. The e-Pathshala channel will be available on DTH channel 53 for home-based learning across the Union Territory. item.title: Cold Wave tightens grip as Kashmir temperatures plunge below Freezing
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 12: A cold wave continued to prevail across the Kashmir region as minimum temperatures remained below the freezing point in most areas. According to data compiled by Kashmir Weather, Srinagar recorded a minimum temperature of minus 2.4 degrees Celsius, while colder conditions prevailed in south and north Kashmir, with Qazigund and Kupwara registering minus 3.6°C and minus 3.7°C, respectively. item.title: Traffic smooth on Jammu–Srinagar Highway as weather improves
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 12: Vehicular traffic is plying smoothly on both sides of the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway on Monday following an improvement in weather conditions, officials said. There was no report of slow movement or congestion on the strategic highway, with traffic moving steadily from both the Jammu and Kashmir ends. Authorities said the improvement in weather had contributed to better road conditions, allowing uninterrupted movement of passenger vehicles as well as essential supply trucks

item.title: Dense Fog delays three morning Flights in Jammu
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 12: Cold weather conditions prevailed across Jammu on Monday morning, with dense fog reducing visibility and affecting normal life and transport movement, officials said. Due to poor visibility during the early hours, vehicular movement on city roads remained thin, with fewer vehicles seen compared to a routine morning.
